svg.title: What is in each cvk tier?
svg.desc: Whole-repository semantic tier guide with verified examples from both Vulkan profiles, all platforms, JSON and helper support.
svg.text: A semantic map of the whole repository: Vulkan + Vulkan SC, core + platform code, generated + authored functions.
Each card names a kind of work, describes its role, and gives actual functions. The SC tag means the corresponding scvk function is also emitted.
The registry-facing layer calls Vulkan, handles results and preserves the wrapper's output contracts.

svg.text: Tier 1 includes builders, extension conveniences and specializations. cvkSetupDeviceLocalBuffer is a specialization; cvkSetupBuffer is a Tier 2 composition.
Platform folders contain multiple tiers. JSON document/pipeline workflows are Tier 3; generated type parsers and shared helpers sit beside the tier stack.
Tests exercise the generated API. Python generation/research tools and CMake are repository tooling; the proposed cvkPlatform* interface is not emitted.
